jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.description: Isometric is the AI-native environmental certification company. Fortune 100 companies need to be certified against regulatory, safety, and sustainability standards. Until now, certification involved a tradeoff: do it fast, or do it right. Never both. Isometric eliminates the tradeoff. We deploy AI agents to make the certification process accurate, instant and invisible—unleashing the potential of the industrial economy. Things you’ll do in this role: Lead Design at Isometric at a pivotal stage of growth – build the team, set the direction and quality bar, and stay hands-on as we scale. Design a complex product that reverses climate change. Certify accelerates the certification of physical infrastructure 50x using agentic workflows and UX that turns dense audit work into something people actually want to use. Shape how Isometric shows up beyond the product – from company brand to swag, sales decks and social media. Things we’re looking for: Deep, end-to-end product craft. You're likely 10 or more years into your career, but we care more about what you've shipped than the number. You've taken complex products from prototype to shipped and iterated – UX, UI, the lot – and you think in systems and services, not just screens. You use AI to design faster and better, and raise everyone around you to do the same. Bonus points for B2B SaaS or technical products. A track record building and leading small, fast design teams along with the delivery and quality processes that hold the bar as they grow. Proactive ownership, pragmatism, and desire to get stuck into whatever is required to move the company forward. This role isn’t for you if: You want a remote job. We value in-person collaboration and spend three days a week in the office. You prefer staying within your area of expertise and operating in structured environments. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Your mission At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible. As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib. Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products. What you'll do Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality. Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen , ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products. Champion an AI-first approach , exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently. Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices , working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization. Drive technical alignment across engineering teams , fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer - Systems & Economy - Fully Remote
jobs.description: At SOFTGAMES, we build games played by millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Game Designer (Systems & Economy) to help evolve our leading games. You will own the long-term evolution of one or two existing games with a loyal player base, balancing player satisfaction, engagement, and commercial performance. In this role, you will own the design and optimization of progression, economy, events, and monetization systems. Your mission is to continuously evolve these games by creating compelling short-, mid-, and long-term goals that keep players engaged for months and years while maximizing player satisfaction and business performance. *Qualified applicants will be expected to complete a design test. This is a remote position. Your Role: Design, balance, and optimize the game’s economy, progression, and reward systems. Create engaging player motivation loops across events, features, and monetization. Develop and maintain a cohesive ecosystem of LiveOps events, ensuring they work together rather than compete for player attention. Design systems that improve retention, engagement, and monetization while preserving a great player experience. Build and maintain economy models, balancing spreadsheets, and simulations. Use data to identify player friction points, progression bottlenecks, and monetization opportunities. Collaborate closely with Product, BI, UA, Art, and Development teams to improve game performance. Analyze KPIs such as Retention, ARPDAU, Conversion, LTV, and Engagement to guide design decisions. Drive feature and event improvements through continuous testing, iteration, and experimentation. Clearly communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations across the team. Your Profile: 5+ years of experience designing and operating successful F2P mobile games. Strong experience in systems design, economy design, progression design, and LiveOps. Proven track record working on casual or puzzle games. Deep understanding of player motivat

Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it.
